report.question: 在闭负曲率测地流的相关函数中，双曲收缩与接触辛几何怎样选出带有波动频率的长期有效演化；这种结论在何种空间、谱隙与高频条件下成立，与完整物理量子理论之间还有什么距离？

4601.scope: Report §2.1; existing 0BL2. Radial contraction of the ambient symplectic volume proves the contact condition.

4602.scope: Report Definition 2.1 and (2.1)-(2.3). Hamilton equations, Legendre substitution and Cartan identity are derived; ordinary smooth-flow existence is reused.

4603.scope: Report Theorem 2.3. Flow definition supplied; negative-curvature implication is quoted from Anosov/report references [4],[66], not reproved.

4604.scope: Report §2.1, §5.2; FT-band-v4 §4.1.2. Invariance, uniform contraction and dimension count give a local complete proof.

4605.scope: Report §2.2 and footnote 1. Correlations and adjoint/Dirac transport conventions derived by change of variables.

4606.scope: Report Theorem 2.5, Remark 2.6; Liverani 2004. Exponential mixing quoted; weak extension and obstruction to strong L2 convergence proved.

4607.scope: Foundation for report §2.4. Local coordinate seminorm definition, distribution pairing and divergence correction; no microlocal regularity theorem claimed.

4608.scope: Report §2.4. Strongly continuous unitary group integral and generator-domain calculation provided for Re z>0.

4609.scope: Report §§2.4-2.5. Operator-valued finite-rank Laurent principal parts defined; meromorphic continuation itself deferred to 460C.

4610.scope: Report Theorem 2.9, (2.12)-(2.13); FT-band-v4 Theorem 1.7, proof §5. Full quoted scalar high-frequency localization and resolvent bound with low-frequency exceptions.

4611.scope: Report Theorem 2.10, Remark 2.11; FT-band-v4 Theorem 1.8, Remark 1.9, (1.17). The spectral cutoff satisfies gamma_{k+1}^+<a<gamma_{k+1}^++epsilon<gamma_k^-; every low-frequency generalized resonance with Re z>a is retained. Arbitrary finite-rank reassignment can change the remainder growth rate. Full band projection/semigroup estimate quoted, not reproved.

4612.scope: Report §2.7, Remark 3.1; FT-band-v4 (1.14), footnote 6; FT-zeta-v4 §2. Line cancellation calculated; nonsmooth bundle and Grassmann extension explicitly retained; no exact global unitarity.

4613.scope: Report (3.1)-(3.2). Matrix brackets and conditional distributional ladder identities proved; preservation of resonant wavefront conditions is cited, not proved.

4614.scope: Report (3.3); DFG-v2 Theorem 1. Algebra proved conditional on nonzero fiber average; inverse construction/multiplicity external; exceptional set and time-reversal conjugacy retained.

4615.scope: Report Remark 3.1 and §6; FT-band-v4 §1.3.7. Spectral calculation on mu>1/4; compact elliptic spectral theorem quoted. Finite low modes, threshold and absent global unitary intertwiner explicit.

4616.scope: Report Theorem 4.1, (4.1), references [5],[59]. Distribution trace formula quoted on t>0 only; no L2 trace-class or t=0 identity.

4617.scope: Report proof following Theorem 4.1. Nondegenerate delta pullback and primitive-period factor calculated; wavefront restriction theorem remains external.

4618.scope: Report Theorem 4.2, (4.2), references [53],[39]. Definition in convergence half-plane and logarithmic derivative computed; entire extension and zero multiplicities quoted.

4619.scope: Report Theorem 4.4; FT-zeta-v4 Theorem 1.2, pp5-6. Meromorphic extension, finite poles/exceptions and infinitely many near-axis zeros quoted; no unjustified single twisted determinant identity.

4620.scope: Report §1.4, §5.3; FT-band-v4 Theorem C.33. Wigner normalization, isometry and onto map proved; covariance uses the stated metaplectic theorem; Sterling commutative diagram expresses exact equality.

4621.scope: Report (5.8), footnote 5; FT-band-v4 Appendix D. Multidimensional monomial calculation and finite-dimensional Taylor asymptotic proved; anisotropic boundedness/completeness not inferred from L2.

4622.scope: Report §5.3 mechanism. Conditional Hilbert tensor operator-norm lemma proved; verifying its hypotheses globally is explicitly external.

4623.scope: Report §5; FT-band-v4 §§2-6. Proof architecture only, with time dependence, Hölder regularity and global errors explicit.

4624.scope: FT-band-v4 Theorem 1.5, (1.12)-(1.13),(1.22),(3.39),(4.34)-(4.35), proof §6; report §5. Scalar specialization, construction data and t-dependent finite-rank remainder stated; theorem quoted.

4625.scope: Report §6 informal discussion. Separates mathematical theorems, quantization comparison and unproved Born/measurement interpretation; no exhaustive current-physics survey.

460A.scope: Report (2.8), explicitly assuming no Jordan blocks. Riesz projection defined; holomorphic functional calculus quoted; finite-dimensional Jordan exponential computed.

460B.scope: Report §5.2; FT-band-v4 §4.2, (4.15)-(4.21). Completion, explicit escape weight, phase-space scales and embeddings stated; slow variation/propagation estimates quoted.

460C.scope: Report §2.4 last paragraphs, references [21],[46]; FT-band-v4 Theorem 4.8. C-dependent space and closed generator domain retained; research theorem quoted.

460D.scope: Report §§2.4,2.7, (5.8); FT-band-v4 §4.3.3. Density transformation law and L2 normalization calculated; source line notation distinguished from transport direction.

460E.scope: Report (2.10),(5.8); FT-band-v4 (4.29),(4.43). Bundle and rank defined; contraction versus inverse expanding-map formulas reconciled; scalar contraction computed.

460F.scope: Report (2.11); FT-band-v4 (1.6)-(1.7). Forward/backward norm growth, determinant/polynomial bounds and explicit sufficient inequality; no curvature-to-Lyapunov comparison theorem imported.

461A.scope: Report §4.3 following (4.3). Exact transverse determinant, geometric series and logarithmic product computation; same oriented-orbit convention retained.

461B.scope: Report §5.1, (5.2); FT-band-v4 §2.5. Euclidean Gaussian resolution of identity proved by Plancherel; global manifold transform remains a cited construction.

461C.scope: Report §5.1; FT-band-v4 §2.3 (2.10). Chain rule, preservation of the canonical form and H=-eta(X) in the site's convention computed.

461D.scope: Report §§5.2-5.3; FT-band-v4 §3.1, Lemma 4.2. Top exterior power and invariance computed; dual hyperbolicity identifies the nonzero trapped set.

461E.scope: FT-band-v4 §1.3.7; report §§5-6. Explicit inverse maps and pullback of canonical one-form prove both branches symplectic; Anosov hypothesis stated for trapped terminology.

461F.scope: Report §5.3; FT-band-v4 Definition C.24, Proposition C.29, Appendix C.8. Weyl formula and adjoint check supplied; existence/covariance of metaplectic representation quoted with double-cover phase boundary.

source_clarifications.detail: v1 (5.6) abbreviates the space as a smooth-function set; use the explicit completion in FT-band-v4 (4.17)-(4.18). No claim of a publisher erratum.
Report §3's wave analogy is restricted by mu<1/4, threshold/Jordan behavior and DFG exceptional parameters; shifting by 1/2 is not exact unitarity for the whole spectrum.
Report uses +X pullback; DFG uses -X forward transport. Velocity reversal conjugates geodesic flows and transfers resonant spaces.
Use flat trace on (0,infinity), not at t=0; no trace-class claim.
Square-root periodic determinant weights are not identically the single half-density-twisted trace in variable curvature; exterior-power construction is external.
v1 §6 says Theorem2.14, while the relevant earlier theorem is 2.10 and its bound is equation(2.14); notes cite correct theorem/equation labels.
Use standard metaplectic double cover; covariance alone fixes phase only, and phase cancels in M tensor conjugate(M). Do not infer a single-valued ordinary representation of the symplectic group.

The cutoff line must lie below the prescribed remainder exponent and above the next band's upper edge. A finite-rank change can introduce a slower-decaying remainder; it does not preserve that exponent automatically.
